'''Al Scott''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 91 from Atlanta, Ga. The fan site's Squadron Members table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He learned the game from his brother-in-law Ken Harrison.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I am a native of Atlanta, Georgia. I have been playing Star Wars CCG for about two years
and running tournaments for the last year. My brother-in-law, Ken Harrison, introduced me to the game, and I've loved it ever since.  Trust me, there is no better way to learn Star Wars CCG than having to play the Number 1 player in the region, over and over and over again. (In other words, I've had
my share of butt kicking's administered by Ken.)

As for the rest of my life, I have a wonderful wife and a very active little
boy, (not to mention another child on the way)  My son is well on his way to being a
very good Star Wars CCG player. Already, at just 18 months, he can identify a card.  Ok, so he just says "card," but it's something. He is also able to empty an entire box of Star Wars cards onto the floor in a matter of minutes. (Trust me on this one)  As for a job, I do Secondary Marketing for a
mortgage banking firm.  I am also very involved in video production at our church.

Well enough about me, I think that this game is great.  I also think that
Decipher has done an excellent job creating this game, insuring that it
remains competitive, and making it enjoyable for every player.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
